versions.changelog:
Initial release — fetches and digests HKEX L&I daily leverage factors with agent-native PDF parsing.

- Discovers latest "Daily Targeted Leverage Factor" announcements for HKEX L&I products and parses PDFs per-run.
- Extracts product leverage factors and applicable trading dates, joining PDF data with HKEX metadata.
- Emits a concise human-readable Telegram digest with product rows in a monospace code block, grouped by date, plus source URLs.
- Ensures safe PDF handling: downloads per run, deletes all files after parsing.
- Fully agent-native: uses curl, jq, and pdftotext (with python3 fallback) for robust extraction.
- Portable, self-contained config and storage; no credentials or hard-coded paths.
